TourAiAssistant: Start an AI chat right inside {{sectionName}}. Ask it to find or organize files, summarize documents or draft text, and add any details it needs for your task.
TourBringFiles: Choose Upload files or Upload folder from New, or drag and drop files into the file list.
TourCreateAnything: Choose New to create documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF forms or folders right in your browser — no extra software needed.
TourCreateFirst: Start a document, a spreadsheet or a presentation, or upload the files you already have. One click, and you are working — with everything you have just seen at hand.
TourCreateFirstEmpty: Start a document, a spreadsheet or a presentation. One click, and you are working — with everything you have just seen at hand.
TourFilesOverview: Files is your place to create, upload and organize documents. Open a file to work on it in your browser, or share it when someone else needs access.
TourFilter: Use the filter to narrow the list by file type or author. Clear the filters to return to the full list.
TourFindFast: Type part of a file name to narrow the list and find what you need.
TourPlacesShared: {{sectionName}} — files and folders others shared with you.
TourPlacesTrash: {{sectionName}} — deleted files you can restore before they are permanently removed.
TourShare: Hover over a file or folder to see quick actions. Use Share to choose who can access it and what they can do, or create an external link when external sharing is available.
TourSharedAccess: {{sharedBy}} shows who shared the item, and {{accessLevel}} shows your permissions. If you need more access, contact the person who shared it.
TourSharedAccessTitle: Who shared it, and what you can do
TourSharedEmpty: Nothing has been shared with you yet. Files and folders will show up here as soon as someone gives you access to them.
TourSharedEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
TourSharedList: Files and folders others share with you appear in {{sectionName}}. Open a file to work on it in your browser — the original stays where it is, so everyone works with the same shared file.
TourView: Use the sort control to order the list, and the view control to switch between list and tile view.
